release_notes: Cloaking now uses separate IP2Proxy LITE PX12, IP2Location ASN LITE and MaxMind GeoLite2-ASN data for proxy, VPN, Tor, datacenter, threat, fraud-score and network detection. The campaign editor now exposes a Keitaro-style Bot: Yes filter; an intercepting Bot: Yes + Do nothing stream catches suspicious traffic while clean traffic continues to regular streams, including KClient Click API integrations. Geo database uploads validate each provider format and no longer confuse PX12 with DB11. Apache campaign aliases work directly at /campaign-alias. Existing Git installations can update from the admin panel; Composer dependencies are installed automatically, unfinished Git conflicts are repaired, and the manual fallback instructions now include the complete safe update command.
